experiences.subtitle: Everything you need for revitalization, fine dining, and peaceful relaxation in Fergana.
experiences.poolDesc: Pristine heated indoor and seasonal outdoor pools surrounded by peaceful leisure seating.
experiences.restaurantDesc: Authentic Fergana culinary treasures, international cuisine, and a sumptuous daily breakfast buffet.

experiences.fitnessDesc: Modern cardio and resistance equipment to keep you invigorated throughout your stay.

about.title: The Essence of Ziyorat Hotel
about.subtitle: A sanctuary where ancient Silk Road warmth meets modern boutique luxury.
about.story: Ziyorat Hotel is a distinguished 4-star boutique hotel situated in a quiet, prestigious quarter of Fergana. We offer international travelers and business guests uncompromising standards of safety, bespoke service, and authentic Uzbek hospitality.
about.bullet2: Turkish hammam, Finnish sauna, and dual pools
about.bullet4: 24/7 reception desk and private secured parking

discover.title: Treasures of the Fergana Valley
discover.subtitle: Ancient craftsmanship, legendary silk factories, and historic khanate palaces.
discover.margilanDesc: Witness firsthand the centuries-old art of handwoven ikat silk production.
discover.rishtanDesc: Explore vibrant studios of master potters crafting iconic cobalt and turquoise glazes.
discover.kokandDesc: The magnificent 19th-century royal palace and architectural jewel of the Kokand Khanate.
discover.ferganaParkDesc: A leafy, peaceful promenade and park just minutes away from our doors.
